# Project Governance 4.4.0

## Improvements

- Projects can deliberately adopt local task-based workflow binding. Routine driver,
  catalog and source edits then receive fresh exact run receipts without repeated
  enrollment or approval dialogs.
- The installed `workflow-bind` command uses the selected runtime and current task.
  Shared-resource ownership, credential filtering, cancellation and cleanup remain
  with their existing owners.
- Development guidance favors isolated checks, focused diagnostics and proportionate
  planning, with broader verification at useful batch and delivery boundaries.

## Adoption and qualification

Adoption is deliberate. Existing installations and default operator approval retain
their behavior. Task mode requires an explicit project profile declaration of
permitted resources and credential environment names. It trusts local project code;
it is not a sandbox or a record of human consent. Changing back to operator mode
stops new policy bindings; existing task withdrawal/cancellation handles bound work.

This stable minor release uses the normal local source, independent review and
exact installed archive qualification path. The separate batch-admission candidate
and concurrent recovery repairs are excluded. Controlled tests establish no live
provider, physical-device, accepted-development or cost-saving claim. Publication
never changes adopter runtime pins or enables the new policy automatically.
